function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_purchase_order_event_write()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if public.is_trusted_purchase_order_write() then
    new.metadata := coalesce(new.metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
      - 'actor_profile_id'
      - 'actor_id'
      - 'sender_profile_id'
      - 'sender_role';
    return new;
  end if;

  raise exception 'Purchase order events must be generated by trusted flows.';
end;
$function$

function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_signature_package_event_write()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op <> 'INSERT' then
    raise exception 'Signature package events are immutable and cannot be changed.';
  end if;

  if public.is_trusted_signature_preparation_write() then
    new.metadata := coalesce(new.metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
      - 'actor_profile_id'
      - 'actor_id'
      - 'sender_profile_id'
      - 'sender_role'
      - 'buyer_id'
      - 'manufacturer_id'
      - 'profile_id'
      - 'organization_id';
    return new;
  end if;

  raise exception 'Signature package events must be generated by trusted flows.';
end;
$function$
